rv.q: This is the most thrilling dance-driven musical since Twyla Tharp's wordless 'Movin' Out' in 2002.
Beneath the considerable pizazz, Wheeldon conveys with grace and style the heartfelt romance and emotional colors that keep us enchanted until the last beautiful note has been sung.
Regardless of the book, the music is glorious, the visuals are innovative and the performances are top-rate.
If 'An American in Paris' fails as an integrated musical, it soars as choreography, and ought to be seen, admired, and appreciated as such.

cn.t: Critics praise Christopher Wheeldon's thrilling choreography and balletic innovation, calling it the most exciting dance-driven musical in years, with glorious music, dazzling visuals, and emotional depth that transcends its film origins.
